body.name: \(\Delta_n(\theta)\)
body.construction: For \(\theta\in\Theta_n\), use the tensor-product collar bumps \((B_j^\theta)_{j=1}^{M_{\mathrm{mix}}^d}\). The centered \(L^2(\lambda)\) separation of the CATE perturbation of amplitude \(q_\tau\) is \[\Delta_n(\theta)=q_\tau\left[(1-2\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}})^d\mu_2^d-(1-2\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}})^{2d}\mu_1^{2d}\right]^{1/2}.\]
